name: Uber
summary: A published step-by-step process for tech roles: talent team, hiring manager, a collaborative technical interview, an exercise and a team interview.

process.note: Uber publishes these steps for its roles. The technical interview applies to tech roles; round contents vary by team.

stages.name: Talent team chat
stages.detail: A conversation with the talent team about your experience, the role and Uber's mission.

stages.name: Hiring manager chat
stages.detail: The hiring manager explores your skills, how you make decisions and how you solve problems at scale.

stages.name: Technical interview
stages.detail: For tech roles, you work through a shared problem or real scenario together in real time.

stages.name: Exercise or assessment
stages.detail: Depending on the role, there may be a functional exercise or assessment.

stages.name: Team interview
stages.detail: Meet teammates and partners, focused on collaboration and decisions; you may present an exercise.

stages.name: Decision
stages.detail: Recruiters and the hiring team review the evidence against the job criteria.

design.note: Design is commonly reported for experienced roles, often around real-time, location-aware systems at large scale.

values.title: How Uber hires
values.summary: We could not find Uber's named values on an official page, so these are themes from its hiring and about pages, in our own words.

items.name: Impact in the real world
items.gist: Uber's work moves people and things, so solutions need to hold up at scale.

items.name: Solve it together
items.gist: Interviews mirror real work: think aloud and build the answer with your interviewer.

items.name: Communication counts
items.gist: Uber says how you reach an answer matters as much as the answer itself.

items.name: Do the right thing
items.gist: Uber describes a culture of acting with integrity and putting safety first.

items.name: Know the role
items.gist: Research the team and the job, and connect your experience to it.

prompts.text: Describe a system or process you changed that affected many people. How did you judge the risk?
Tell a story where you solved a hard problem live with others. How did you share your thinking?
Talk about a time you chose the right outcome for users over an easier shortcut.
Share a decision you made with incomplete data. What did you weigh, and what happened?

mock.note: Follows the published steps for tech roles: a collaborative technical interview, an exercise round and a team interview.
